subject: Biology
content: Which of the following structures is present in prokaryotes but lacks membrane-bound compartmentalization?
explanation: Prokaryotic cells possess 70S ribosomes and infoldings of plasma membrane called mesosomes for respiration/cell wall formation, but completely lack membrane-bound organelles such as Golgi, ER, and mitochondria.

distractor_explanations.D: CONCEPTUAL_ERROR: Mitochondria are membrane-bound eukaryotic organelles.

subject: Biology
content: During which sub-stage of Prophase I of Meiosis does crossing over between non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes take place?
explanation: Synapsis forms the bivalent/tetrad during Zygotene, but crossing over (exchange of genetic material) occurs specifically during Pachytene stage, mediated by enzyme recombinase.

distractor_explanations.B: CONCEPTUAL_ERROR: Zygotene is the stage of synapsis and synaptonemal complex formation, before crossing over.
distractor_explanations.C: CONCEPTUAL_ERROR: Diplotene is dissolution of synaptonemal complex leaving chiasmata.

subject: Biology
content: A heterozygous tall pea plant with violet flowers (TtVv) is test crossed with a dwarf white plant (ttvv). What proportion of progeny will be dwarf with violet flowers assuming independent assortment?
explanation: Test cross of dihybrid TtVv x ttvv yields equal phenotypic ratio of 1:1:1:1 (Tall Violet : Tall White : Dwarf Violet : Dwarf White). Hence Dwarf with Violet flowers is 1/4 or 25%.

distractor_explanations.B: CALCULATION_ERROR: Multiplied one trait probability without second trait test ratio.
distractor_explanations.C: CARELESS_ERROR: Confused with trihybrid test cross.
distractor_explanations.D: FORMULA_SELECTION_ERROR: Used 1/16 from 9:3:3:1 F2 selfing ratio instead of test cross.

subject: Biology
content: In Morgan's experiments with Drosophila, cross A (yellow body, white eyes) showed 1.3% recombination, while cross B (white eye, miniature wing) showed 37.2% recombination. What conclusion follows regarding the genes?

options.text: Body color and eye color genes are tightly linked (physically closer on the X-chromosome)
Eye color and wing size genes are located on different autosomes
Recombination frequency is inversely proportional to physical distance between genes
Cross A exhibits complete absence of linkage

explanation: Recombination frequency directly correlates with physical distance between linked genes on the same chromosome. A low recombination frequency of 1.3% indicates very tight linkage (close physical proximity) on the X chromosome.

distractor_explanations.B: CONCEPTUAL_ERROR: Both genes were on X chromosome; 37.2% indicates loose linkage, not independent assortment on different chromosomes.
distractor_explanations.C: CONCEPTUAL_ERROR: Frequency is directly proportional, not inversely proportional to distance.
distractor_explanations.D: CARELESS_ERROR: 1.3% recombinant means 98.7% parental, proving strong linkage.
